_note: Fiches en anglais (vocabulaire Maramani, décision de Tao du 28 nov. 2026). Lot 1 : 10 modèles à faire relire par Tao. Traduites depuis les fiches françaises (get_plan) ; aucun chiffre ajouté : surfaces, chambres et dimensions viennent de la base.

V4-005.summary: A contemporary 4 bedroom bungalow with a master bedroom en-suite, 3 bathrooms and a guest toilet.
V4-005.description: This contemporary bungalow offers 201 square meters of living space. It has 2 entrance halls, a large living room, a dining room, a kitchen, a store, 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and a guest toilet. The master bedroom comes with 2 closets and a spacious en-suite.

V3-017.summary: A family bungalow with 3 bedrooms, including a master bedroom with a walk-in closet.
V3-017.description: A family bungalow with 3 bedrooms. It has 2 living rooms, a dining room, a kitchen, a store, a master bedroom with a walk-in closet, 2 more bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.

D5-012.summary: A two-story house of 234 square meters with a master bedroom en-suite, an office and a garage.
D5-012.description: A two-story house of 234 square meters. The ground floor has 2 living rooms, a dining room, a kitchen, an office, a store, a garage, a guest toilet and a guest bedroom. The first floor has 3 bedrooms, including the master bedroom en-suite, and 3 terraces.

V4-036.summary: A contemporary tropical bungalow with large glass windows and a stone and wood façade.
V4-036.description: A contemporary bungalow that combines elegance and practicality in a tropical setting. It offers generous living spaces, large glass windows and a refined façade mixing natural stone and wood, for a comfortable lifestyle.

V4-032.summary: A family bungalow with 4 bedrooms, including a master bedroom en-suite, 3 bathrooms and a large living room.
V4-032.description: A family bungalow with 4 bedrooms, including a master bedroom en-suite. It has a large living room and 3 bathrooms.

D4-034.summary: A modern two-story house of 143 square meters, designed for a narrow plot.
D4-034.description: A modern two-story house with 4 comfortable bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. The practical layout includes terraces and generous living spaces for a family. The ground floor has an entrance hall, a living room, a dining room, a kitchen, a guest bedroom and a bathroom. The first floor has 3 bedrooms, a walk-in closet, 2 bathrooms and a terrace.

D4-006.summary: A contemporary two-story house of 195 square meters with a guest bedroom on the ground floor.
D4-006.description: A contemporary two-story house of 195 square meters. Ground floor: a living and dining room, a guest bedroom with its own shower and closet, a laundry, a kitchen and a guest toilet. First floor: 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The master suite has a walk-in closet and an en-suite.

V3-001.summary: A modern 3 bedroom bungalow of 92 square meters with two terraces.
V3-001.description: This modern bungalow offers 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Its practical layout centres on a large open living and dining area, with two terraces to enjoy the outdoors.

V5-002.summary: A family bungalow with 5 bedrooms, 2 living rooms and a veranda.
V5-002.description: A family bungalow with 5 bedrooms, including a master bedroom en-suite. It has 2 living rooms, a dining room, a kitchen, 3 bathrooms, a store, a guest toilet and a veranda.

D5-001.summary: A modern two-story house of 325 square meters with an L-shaped terrace and a garage for 3 cars.
D5-001.description: A modern two-story house designed for a large family. Ground floor: 2 spacious living rooms and a dining room opening onto an L-shaped terrace, a large guest bedroom with a closet and an en-suite, a second bedroom with a shared shower room, a guest toilet, a kitchen and a garage for 3 cars. First floor: a family lounge, 3 bedrooms including the master bedroom, and 2 bathrooms.
